label: Form 1098-E student loan interest statement vocabulary and per-statement eligibility witnesses for 2025

fact_types.title: Student loan interest received by lender, reported in box 1 of one logical Form 1098-E statement instance furnished by a lender for 2025; the statement instance is peer to evidence and its identity carries no file, upload, scan, document, or evidence key (ADR-0015). Multiple originals from one lender are distinct statement instances; a lender may aggregate several qualified student loans on one statement. A corrected copy of the same logical statement answers this same fact and supersedes its prior finding. A VOID-checked copy is never admitted as this fact at all -- it is not a member, not a correction, not evidence of anything (mirrors tax.us.2025.f1099g.box1-unemployment's VOID disposition exactly). Nonnegative source amount only.

Explicit companion authority for Form 1098-E box 2 (box 1 does not include loan origination fees and/or capitalized interest for a pre-9/1/2004 loan) on the same logical statement as a box-1 member. Read directly off the statement itself, not a separate taxpayer declaration. Only explicit null (absent, meaning unchecked) or boolean false (explicitly unchecked) is admissible on the bounded Student Loan Interest Deduction route. A true value (box 2 checked) is a hard admission block: box 1 is known-incomplete for that statement and this route's worksheet arithmetic cannot honestly perform Pub. 970's manual fee-allocation computation (ADR-0016 section 5, mirrors tax.us.2025.f1099g.box4-federal-withholding-authority's companion-witness pattern). This is an authority witness, not a composed amount.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no related-person loan interest is included in this statement's box-1 figure (Pub. 970 p.31, "Related person"). Per-statement witness on the same logical statement as the box-1 member. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no qualified-employer-plan loan interest is included in this statement's box-1 figure (Pub. 970 p.31, "Qualified employer plan"). Per-statement witness on the same logical statement as the box-1 member. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no non-qualified-loan component is included in this statement's box-1 figure -- collapses the student-status, qualified-education-expense, and reasonable-period-of-time sub-questions Pub. 970 (pp.30-31, "Qualified Student Loan," "Qualified Education Expenses," "Reasonable period of time") gives no per-return signal to distinguish, folded into one contributed absence witness (mirrors the box-4-style "authority witness, not a composed amount" pattern used elsewhere in this codebase, e.g. tax.us.2025.f1099g.box4-federal-withholding-authority). Per-statement witness on the same logical statement as the box-1 member. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no employer-paid interest under an educational assistance program (post-3/27/2020) is included in this statement's box-1 figure (Pub. 970 p.33, "No Double Benefit Allowed"). Per-statement witness on the same logical statement as the box-1 member. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

Student Loan Interest Deduction eligibility component: no QTP (qualified tuition program) distribution-earnings amount was used to pay the interest reported on this statement (Pub. 970 p.33, "No Double Benefit Allowed"). Per-statement witness on the same logical statement as the box-1 member. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default. yes asserts the named excluded class is absent; no asserts it is present and blocks the whole route.

User-attested closure of the Form 1098-E box-1 student-loan-interest source family for 2025, keyed on the family membership horizon current at attestation (ADR-0017): true asserts every furnished 1098-E box-1 interest amount is recorded as of that horizon. This claim covers box 1 (and its box-2 companion) only -- never the eligibility components (universal or legal-zero), MAGI completeness, Schedule 1 Part II completeness, or Form 1040 line 10/11a/11b. A later membership transition displaces this closure through horizon succession; re-attestation on the successor horizon is required.
